profile.Name: Longen
profile.Personality: The most powerful man in the Empire without a crown, and pleased about it. He thinks in prices and leverage.
profile.Backstory: He runs the Traders Guild from Trader's Edge. The Guild was powerful before him and is more powerful now, and he would pay well to see Tinfist dead.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks in the language of trade and profit; calmly offers money to solve problems.
